newsitem.title: USA: Koala chairman resigns, CEO is succeessor.
newsitem.headline: Koala chairman resigns, CEO is succeessor.

text.p: Koala Corp said Thursday that Mark Betker, its president and chief executive officer, has been named chairman, succeeding Jeff Hilger, who has resigned from Koala's board of directors.
The company said another director, Donald Brattain, has also decided to leave the Koala board.
The company, which recently relocated from Minneapolis to Denver, said Hilger and Brattain are residents of the Minneapolis-St. Paul area.

The company said Hilger, who founded Koala, began his transition out with Betker's appointment as chief executive in 1995. It said Brattain decided to leave because of "other pressing time commitments."
The maker of infant and child products said the number of its board members has been reduced to five members from six.
